Kerala to Establish Panel to Study Vizhinjam Deal

The Kerala government plans to set up a panel to examine the proposed Adani-MSC Vizhinjam deal, amid controversy over the stake sale. The move comes after opposition criticism and allegations that the previous LDF government was aware of the proposal. The issue has sparked debate over the state's interests in the project.
